messages:
ana: quick thought — want to run a shadow routing cohort for v2 but with backpressure so we can measure real traffic behavior without risking v1 users. sketch attached below.

dmitri: +1. what are the failure/fallback semantics you want for the cohort?

ana: idea: route 5% of traffic to v2 in parallel (no effect on response), and for a subset (1%) actually switch the request path and apply soft backpressure: if v2 latency spikes or 5xxs increase we throttle to 0% for that tenant and fall back to v1.

jamie: can we do per-tenant opt-in so integrators can opt into the hard-switch probe? otherwise noisy tenants will skew metrics.

ana: yep — two cohorts: "shadow-only" (5%) and "probe-switch" (1%, opt-in). default probe-only for internal tenants.

lee: what telemetry do we capture? we need to avoid creating a huge cardinality explosion.

ana: minimal signals first: 
- request_version (v1|v2)
- cohort (control|shadow|probe)
- decision (served_v1|served_v2|fallback_v1)
- latency_p50_p95_p99 buckets (per-model, per-route)
- error_cls (5xx|4xx|timeout)
- tenant_id hashed bucket (to keep cardinality bounded)

sara: for dashboards: add a single panel comparing p95 between v1 control and v2 shadow by route. then an alert when probe fallback ratio > 2% over 5m for a tenant.

dmitri: alerting on per-tenant fallback ratio seems noisy. maybe alert on global probe fallback rate, then surface top-N tenants causing rollbacks.

ana: agreed — global alert + tenant breakdown. also plan to capture rollforward/backoff counters so we can measure how often we automatically throttle a tenant.

jamie: UX on console — can we show expected quota delta when someone opts into probe-switch? i.e., estimate extra tokens/requests and expected extra cost.

ana: good call. we can add an affordance: "Opt-in expected impact: +X% tokens, +Y cost/mo, risk level: low/med/high" based on historical traffic.

lee: operationally, how do we apply backpressure? simple token-bucket per-tenant on v2 ingress, configured via rollout policy. sample config:
```yaml
rollout_policies:
  - name: shadow-5pct
    selector: random(5%)
    action: mirror_to_v2
  - name: probe-switch-1pct
    selector: random(1%) AND tenant_opt_in
    action: route_to_v2_with_backpressure
    backpressure: 
      latency_threshold_ms: 800
      error_threshold_pct: 3
      throttle_step: 25%
      throttle_cooldown_s: 300
```

jamie: make sure throttle_step is additive and respects tenant reserved capacity. we can't throttle below reserved baseline.

ana: yes, reserve floor for Dedicated customers. if throttle would breach reservation, fallback to v1 but mark as "reservation-exempt-fallback" in telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary started for "shadow-5pct" and "probe-switch-1pct" on staging at 1728007000

dmitri: timeline? when do we flip from observational to hard probe on production tenants?

ana: target: 2 weeks of shadow-only collection, then enable probe-switch for internal tenants, watch for 48h, then open opt-in via console.

lee: question: sampling — how do we ensure the same tenant stays in same cohort across day boundaries to get stable metrics?

ana: use a stable hash of tenant_id mod 10000 with bucket thresholds. store cohort assignment in routing cache for 24h to handle sticky behavior.

jamie: telemetry retention for the new fields — increase to 60d for the cohort metrics to analyze regressions over time? costy but useful. maybe 30d first.

ana: start with 30d; product can request longer for specific tenants.

sara: dashboard wireframe note: add a small cell showing "console opt-in adoption" per workspace so PMs can nudge customers.

dmitri: rollout playbook item: auto-disable probe-switch for any tenant with fallback_rate > 5% in 15m window. record action in audit log.

ana: agreed. action items: 
- ana: PR for policy config + routing hash (due EOD Tue)
- lee: telemetry schema + mapping to metrics team (due Wed)
- sara: dashboard mockups + alert thresholds (due Thu)
- jamie: console affordance copy + opt-in flow (due Fri)
- dmitri: runbook entries and automated rollback (due next Mon)

jamie: +1 on action items. can we add a small note in console about deprecation of implicit v1 routing when probe-switch reaches 30% adoption? want to be careful with wording.

ana: we'll avoid any deprecation text for now; just "migration assist". deprecation comms later when we have stable signals.

dmitri: one more: metric names spelling convention: use prefix rtf_ for rollout telemetry flags (rtf.cohort, rtf.decision, rtf.fallback_reason). keep consistent for downstream alerts.

ana: good. I'll include naming in the PR.

deploy-bot: staging canary succeeded for shadow-5pct at 1728008800, no regressions observed.

lee: thanks. I'll queue telemetry schema review.

ana: thanks team. we'll sync after the PR reviews and pick a date for prod shadow only. :thumbsup:
